notes.title: 'Last Order' has officially released today!
notes.content:
We have officially released 'Last Order'!
We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who was involved in the Early Access.

We hope you all enjoy the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43497849/c76857f6dc561fc62be66079d4c90f701324a5f5.png[/img]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Implemented a new stage, "Radio Tower".
[*]Implemented multiple endings.
[*]Added new Order Chips.
[*]Added new NPC events.
[*]Added support for DualSense controller input.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked the Order Chip 'Adeptness'.
[*]Reworked the Order Chip 'Aerobatics'.
[*]Adjusted the balance of existing Order Chips.
[*]Adjusted the balance of existing bosses and stages.
[*]Remake of the battle against Habakiri in the memories.
[*]Reorganized the tutorial structure.
[*]Rebalanced the cost of permanent enhancements.
[*]Increased the base action speed of Emergency Heal.
[*]And other minor balance adjustments.
[*]Added multiple tutorial messages providing gameplay tips.
[*]Added a feature to view details of Order Chips after acquiring them.
[*]Changed the expression of the dialogue appearing at the top of the screen to make it more noticeable.
[*]And other minor usability improvements.
[*]Enhanced graphics and sounds.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]
